tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground under the sky gradient; top bar and footer at 60–70% over it.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on every glass surface.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Glass panel base, laid over the sky at glass-alpha (86% dawn, 68% night) with an 18 px blur and 170% saturation.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Tracks, skeletons, hover fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: tile edges, list dividers, top bar and footer rules. Never a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on tile and panel links.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of every input, select and the range-toggle track. 3.86:1 dawn / 4.16:1 night on glass.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels, subtitles, notes, stale values.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand fill: the brand mark and the default button.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill (5.58:1 dawn, 9.02:1 night).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: River teal as ink: links, eyebrow, panel icons, focus ring, chart series, comet head, hero numbers, ridge rim light. Never a status.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Panel-icon tile behind accent-text.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Apricot dusk light: the alpenglow sweep and the horizon. Scenery only, never UI text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status only: healthy, online, passing. Meadow green, 52° of hue away from the teal.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status only: degraded, stale, pending, reconnecting, threshold markers.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Status only: offline, failing, critical, on battery. Always a solid-filled chip with an icon, never a tint.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Label on a solid status chip (fail 6.64:1 dawn, 6.3:1 night).

tokens.name: sky-0
tokens.usage: Sky gradient stop at 0% (top).

tokens.name: sky-1
tokens.usage: Sky gradient stop at 40%.

tokens.name: sky-2
tokens.usage: Sky gradient stop at 66%.

tokens.name: sky-3
tokens.usage: Sky gradient stop at 84%: the dusk band begins.

tokens.name: sky-4
tokens.usage: Sky gradient stop at 100%: apricot horizon behind the ridge.

tokens.name: ridge-far
tokens.usage: Far range silhouette.

tokens.name: ridge-mid
tokens.usage: Near range, top of its gradient.

tokens.name: ridge-near
tokens.usage: Near range, bottom of its gradient. Kept misty in dawn so glass over it keeps AA.

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Snowfields above the snowline (top 22% of the band), alpenglow-tinted at night.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1 px glass rim.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Inner top highlight of glass.

tokens.name: glass-glint
tokens.usage: Specular glint top-left of each glass panel.

tokens.name: glass-drop
tokens.usage: Colour of the glass depth shadow.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: Hero totals; the live hero number in accent-text.

spacing.note: Lengths stay literal steps (2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32); only panel padding and the band are variables.

tokens.name: panel-pad
tokens.usage: Panel padding below 1280 px.

tokens.name: panel-pad-1280
tokens.usage: Panel padding at ≥1280 px (kiosk).

tokens.name: panel-pad-639
tokens.usage: Panel padding below 640 px.

tokens.name: band-height
tokens.usage: Ridgeline band height at the bottom of the frame.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Unused today; proposed for toggle items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles, skeletons, tooltips, the panel-icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons and alerts (shadcn rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-glass
tokens.usage: Glass panels and the verdict strip.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and meters.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass panel.

tokens.name: shadow-tone-warn
tokens.usage: Panel tone=warn: ring plus a soft neon halo.

tokens.name: shadow-tone-fail
tokens.usage: Panel tone=fail.

tokens.name: shadow-mark
tokens.usage: Brand mark glow.

tokens.name: glass-alpha-light
tokens.usage: Panel opacity in dawn: the floor that keeps every text token ≥4.5:1 over the darkest backdrop.

tokens.name: glass-alpha-dark
tokens.usage: Panel opacity at night: the same floor.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur radius.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter saturation.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and border transitions.

tokens.name: dur
tokens.usage: Hover lift, ticker row entrance.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panel entrance, meter width.

tokens.name: dur-tween
tokens.usage: Live number tween (cubic ease-out).

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: Chart first draw.

tokens.name: dur-event
tokens.usage: Event pulse: live-dot ripple, hero-number flash.

tokens.name: dur-ping
tokens.usage: Alarm dot ping.

tokens.name: dur-sweep
tokens.usage: Alpenglow sweep across the ridge, linear, infinite.

tokens.name: dur-aurora
tokens.usage: Aurora drift, alternate.

tokens.name: dur-twinkle
tokens.usage: Star twinkle, staggered.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Panel entrance delay per index.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every transition and keyframe except the sweep (linear).
